title: Hosted search availability versus local native tools on offline coding
hypothesis: Removing unused hosted search from explicitly offline coding requests lowers time to a verified solution without changing native tools or correctness.
falsified_if: The treatment fails activation, loses per-task correctness, or fails the registered latency gate; fewer schema tokens alone do not establish a speed win.
local_evidence: The provider appends hosted web_search to normal requests. Native tools remain identical under the new local_only scope. Official tool configuration: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/tools-web-search . No assumption about the endpoint token cost of an unused hosted tool. Earlier effort validation failed to replicate; keep explicit high in both arms.

task_suffixes.simple_prompt: This task is self-contained; do not browse or use external network services.
task_suffixes.ambiguous_bug_investigation: File scope: change only checkout/cache.py and checkout/service.py. Do not add files. This task is self-contained; do not browse or use external network services.
task_suffixes.multifile_order_cancellation: File scope: change only orders/__init__.py, orders/api.py, orders/models.py, orders/repository.py and orders/service.py. Do not add files. This task is self-contained; do not browse or use external network services.
task_suffixes.failure_recovery: File scope: change only shipping/quotes.py. Do not add files. This task is self-contained; do not browse or use external network services.

deterministic_outcomes: actual serialized provider tools exactly equal native baseline with or without only web_search
unchanged model effort prompt and task contracts
efficiency_outcomes: aggregate coding elapsed time including failures
input output cached tokens and complete estimated cost
first-response input token attribution when available
decision_rule: Seed 914. Four separate smoke runs: simple_prompt and ambiguous_bug_investigation, both arms. Then 24 pilot runs: four scenarios, three repetitions, two arms. Maximum 28 launches, $7 between-run standard-equivalent estimated cost threshold (one-run overshoot possible), 1800 active worker seconds. Stop on smoke failures or protocol/activation failures. No retries or failed-run exclusion. Exclude smoke/arithmetic from primary outcomes, include all attempts in spend. Continue only with no per-task pass-count loss, at least 15% lower aggregate coding elapsed time, lower median latency on at least two of three coding tasks, and no more than 10% cost increase. Otherwise reject this speed route on the tested cohort; retain evidence without adopting a default. If qualified, validate freshly on existing_codebase_edit, context_boundary_edit and stable_verification_regression, three repeats, same gates, before a conditional offline recommendation. No long-task or global browsing claim. Inspect actual usage and tool traces rather than inferring savings from local serialized bytes. Compare contemporaneous controls only. Ordinary production browsing remains unchanged. local_only is a tool-availability ablation, not a network sandbox.
